units.source_text: 我回答说，出门之前，我想先去仔细地看看金阁，

en.t: I answered that before setting out, I wanted first to go and take a careful look at the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 因为说不定明天这个时间里就再看不见金闯了。

en.t: because by this time tomorrow, perhaps I would no longer be able to see the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 也许在我们去工厂期间，金阁就遭到空袭，毁于一旦了。

en.t: Perhaps while we were away at the factory, the Golden Pavilion would be hit in an air raid and destroyed in an instant.

units.source_text: 我这番话没有把握，结结巴巴地说了出来。

en.t: I had no certainty behind these words, and I stammered them out.

units.source_text: 这时候，鹤川吃惊而又不耐烦地听着。

en.t: At that moment, Tsurukawa listened in surprise and with impatience.
